```{python filename="MultiConn_parcellation.py"}
# | output: false

import mindmap as mm
from scripts.utils import check_files
from scripts.data_manager import SimfManager

overwrite = False

# data manager
fconfig = "simf.config.yml"
dm = SimfManager(fconfig)

# output files
entities = dict(space="fs", segmentation="multiconn2022", scale="4")
fseg = dm.get_path("10", "dseg", **entities)
fclut = dm.get_path("10", "dseg", extension=".txt", **entities)

if check_files([fseg, fclut]) and not overwrite:
  raise FileExistsError("Output file already exists!")

# 1. Run the MultiConn parcellation pipeline
multiconn = mm.anatomy.parcellation.parcellate_multiconn(
  sub = "10",
  fconfig = fconfig,
  margin = 2,       # White matter extension in [mm]
  thresh = 0.05,    # Probability threshold to discretize thalamus atlas
  verbose = 1,
)

# 2. Save data
multiconn.save(
  fseg,
  fclut,
)
```

```{python filename="setup_source_space.py"}
# | output: false

import mne
import mindmap as mm
from scripts.utils import check_files
from scripts.data_manager import SimfManager

overwrite = True
sub = "10"

# data manager
dm = SimfManager("simf.config.yml")

# output files
fsrc = dm.get_path(sub, "src")

if check_files([fsrc]) and not overwrite:
  raise FileExistsError("Output file already exists!")

# 0. Load data
ctx = dm.load(sub, "ctx", space="fs", segmentation="multiconn2022", scale="4")
ras2tkras = dm.load(sub, "ras2tkras")

source_space = mne.setup_source_space(
  subject = f"sub-{sub}",
  spacing = "oct6",
  surface = "white",
  add_dist = True,
  subjects_dir = dm.config["DIR_FS"],
  n_jobs = 10,
  verbose = "warning",
)

source_space = mm.anatomy.source_space.filter_dipoles_by_nifti_mask(source_space, ctx, ras2tkras)

source_space.save(fsrc, overwrite=overwrite)
```

import ants

# -----------------

# 0. Load data
#brain = dm.load(sub, "brain.mgz")

ras2tkras = dm.load(sub, "ras2tkras")
vol_info = dm.load(sub, "vol-info")
bem_labels = dm.get_bem_labels()

# 1. brain surface (used to force inner skull to be outside of brain mask)
#brain_mask = mm.anatomy.mri.nibabel_to_ants(brain)
#brain_mask = ants.threshold_image(brain_mask, low_thresh=0.5, high_thresh=None, inval=1, outval=0)
#brain_mask = brain_mask.morphology("close", radius=10)

#brain_surf, brain_interop = mm.anatomy.forward.fit_surface_to_mri_mask(brain_mask, n_smooth=20)
#brain_surf = mm.geometry.polydata_transform(brain_surf, ras2tkras)


# 2. Build BEM layers from CHARM segmentation

```{python filename="eeg_template_coregistration.py"}
# | output: false

import mindmap as mm
from scripts.utils import check_files
from scripts.data_manager import SimfManager

overwrite = True

# data manager
dm = SimfManager("simf.config.yml")
sub = "10"

# output files
ftmp = dm.get_path(sub, "ave-temp")

if check_files([ftmp]) and not overwrite:
  raise FileExistsError("Output file already exists!")

# Make template and coregister to head model
ave_tmp = mm.analysis.functional.eeg.build_eeg_template(
  duration = 20,         # in [s]
  frequency = 250,
  montage = "spike",    # EGI 256 channel cap with removed cheeks
)

ave_tmp = mm.anatomy.forward.template_coregistration(
  ave_tmp,
  f"sub-{sub}",
  dm.roots["fs"],
  iterations = 0
)

# save coregistered template
ave_tmp.save(ftmp, overwrite=overwrite)
```


```{python filename="forward_problem.py"}
# | output: false

import mne
import mindmap as mm
from scripts.utils import check_files
from scripts.data_manager import SimfManager

overwrite = True

# data manager
dm = SimfManager("simf.config.yml")
sub = "10"

# output files
ffwd_sim = dm.get_path(sub, "fwd", desc="sim")
ffwd_inv = dm.get_path(sub, "fwd", desc="inv")

if check_files([ffwd_sim, ffwd_inv]) and not overwrite:
  raise FileExistsError("Output file already exists!")

# 0. Load data
ave = dm.load(sub, "ave-temp")
trans = dm.load(sub, "eeg-trans")
src = dm.load(sub, "src")

# ----------------------------------------------------
# 1. Compute forward for simulations
# ¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨
# Use default conductivities.
# ----------------------------------------------------

# 1.1 Assemble BEM 
model = mne.make_bem_model(
  subject = f"sub-{sub}",
  subjects_dir = dm.roots["fs"],
  conductivity = [0.3, 0.006, 0.3],
  ico = None,
  verbose = "warning",
)

bem = mne.make_bem_solution(model)

# 1.2 Compute forward solution
forward = mne.make_forward_solution(
  info = ave.info,
  trans = trans,
  src = src,
  bem = bem,
  meg = False,
  eeg = True,
  verbose = "warning",
)

# 1.3 Save solution
mne.write_forward_solution(ffwd_sim, forward, overwrite, verbose="warning")

# ----------------------------------------------------
# 2. Compute forward for source reconstruction
# ¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨¨
# Change skull conductivity to introduce model errors
# and avoid commiting  "inverse crimes".
# ----------------------------------------------------

# 2.1 Assemble BEM 
model = mne.make_bem_model(
  subject = f"sub-{sub}",
  subjects_dir = dm.roots["fs"],
  conductivity = [0.3, 0.012, 0.3],   # -> different skull conductivity to generate 10% errors
  ico = None,
  verbose = "warning",
)

bem = mne.make_bem_solution(model)

# 2.2 Compute forward solution
forward = mne.make_forward_solution(
  info = ave.info,
  trans = trans,
  src = src,
  bem = bem,
  meg = False,
  eeg = True,
  verbose = "warning",
)

# 2.3 Save solution
mne.write_forward_solution(ffwd_inv, forward, overwrite, verbose="warning")
```


```{python filename="connectivity.py"}
# | output: false

import numpy as np
import pygsp
import mindmap as mm
from scripts.utils import check_files
from scripts.data_manager import SimfManager

overwrite = True

# data manager
dm = SimfManager("simf.config.yml")
sub = "10"

# output files
fcon = dm.get_path(sub, "con")
feig = dm.get_path(sub, "eig")

if check_files([fcon, feig]) and not overwrite:
  raise FileExistsError("Output file already exists!")

# 0. load data
src = dm.load(sub, "fwd", desc="sim")["src"]
tracto = dm.load(sub, "tractogram")
t12diff = dm.load(sub, "t12diff")
ctx = dm.load(sub, "ctx", space="fs", segmentation="multiconn2022", scale="4")
ras2tkras = dm.load(sub, "ras2tkras")

# 1. build (length) connectivity matrix from tractography
pruned_tracto = mm.anatomy.tractogram.prune_tracts(tracto, ctx, t12diff)
con_tracto = mm.analysis.connectivity.connectome_from_tracts(
  pruned_tracto,
  src,
  t12diff,
  ras2tkras, 
  lengths = True
)

# 2. merge geometry connectivity
con_geom = mm.analysis.connectivity.connectome_from_geometry(
  src,
  maximum_dist = 15,   # maximum distance to establish connection
  maximum_neigh = 3,  # maximum number of neighbor to consider
  weights = True,     # Use geodesic distance as weight
)

con = con_tracto.copy()
geom_idx = np.argwhere(con_geom > 0)
con[geom_idx[:,0], geom_idx[:,1]] = con_geom[geom_idx[:,0], geom_idx[:,1]]

# 3. compute Connectome Spectrum Transform
G = pygsp.graphs.Graph(con, lap_type="normalized")
G.compute_fourier_basis()
eigvec = G.U
eigval = G.e

# 4. Save outputs
np.save(fcon, con, allow_pickle=True)
mm.core.write_eig(feig, eigvec, eigval)
```


```{python filename="simulation.py"}
# | output: false

import mindmap as mm
from scripts.data_manager import SimfManager
from scripts.utils import check_files

overwrite = False

# data manager
dm = SimfManager("simf.config.yml")
sub = "10"

# output folder
fsim = dm.roots["sim"]
if check_files([fsim]) and not overwrite:
  raise ValueError("Simulation folder already exists.")

# load data
fwd = dm.load(sub, "fwd", desc="sim")
con = dm.load(sub, "con")
eeg = dm.load(sub, "ave-temp")
parc = dm.load(sub, "dseg", space="fs", segmentation="multiconn2022", scale="4")
ras2tkras = dm.load(sub, "ras2tkras")

# build simulation
spike = mm.analysis.simulation.SpikeSignal(
  width = 0.1,    # in [ms]
  onset = 0.5,    # in [ms]
  repeat = 1,     # in [ms]
  scale = 1e-8,   # in [A]
  event_id = 1,
)

# head model
head_model = mm.analysis.simulation.HeadModel(
  sensors = eeg,
  forward = fwd,
  connectivity_weights = con > 0,
  connectivity_lengths = con,
  parcellation = parc,
  ras2tkras = ras2tkras,
)

# Epoch configuration
epoch_config = mm.analysis.simulation.EpochConfig(
  tmin = -0.45,                   # in [s]
  tmax = 0.45,                    # in [s]
  baseline = (-0.45, -0.2),       # in [s]
  signal_window = (-0.1, 0.45),   # in [s]
)

# Propagation configuration
prop_config = mm.analysis.simulation.PropagationConfig(
  conduction_speed = 30,          # in [mm/ms]
  nodal_delay = 10,               # in [ms]
  spatial_decay = 0.5,            # [0-1]
  jitter = 1,                     # in [ms]
)

sim = mm.analysis.simulation.Simulator(head_model, epoch_config)

# run 30 simulations for every brain region
brain_regions = parc.clut["Label name"]
sources = [mm.analysis.simulation.Source([br], spike) for br in brain_regions]

mm.analysis.simulation.generate_simulation_dataset(
  dm = dm,
  subject = sub,
  simulator = sim,
  sources = sources,
  prop_config = prop_config,
  repetitions = 30,
  snr_target = 10.0,
  base_seed = 42,
  entities = {"task":"spk"},
)
```
